svg.text: JUDICIARY INFORMATION SYSTEM (JIS) — FUTURE ENTERPRISE SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
Target Architecture: End-to-End E-Courts Lifecycle Integrated with Active Statutory & Precedent Repository
Repository Engine, Real Verified Judgments & PDFs
Target Modules (Not Currently Implemented in Demo)
1. USER & PERSONA ACCESS PORTALS [PLANNED / FUTURE SCOPE — NOT CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED]
• Public Case Status by CNR / Case No.
• Daily Cause List View by Courtroom
2. SECURITY, IDENTITY & API GATEWAY LAYER [PLANNED / FUTURE SCOPE — NOT CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED]
Rate limiting, TLS 1.3 termination, CORS & DDOS shield
Judges, Advocates, Registrars, Litigants, 2FA Auth & Audit Tokens
Digital Signature (DSC) verification, SHA-256 chain-of-custody logging
3. MODULAR APPLICATION SERVICES (PLANNED E-COURTS WORKFLOW SERVICES + ACTIVE PRODUCTION REPOSITORY)
• Immutable log stream for filings & orders
• User IP, action delta & state capture
• 2,419 Statutory Sections across Old & New Criminal Codes
• Verified PDF Streaming Pipeline (98 Authentic Documents)
• Case overview, issues, holdings & 5-7 legal findings
4. PERSISTENCE & STORAGE ARCHITECTURE (PLANNED E-COURTS STORES + ACTIVE PRODUCTION LEGAL REPOSITORY)
• S3 / MinIO Compliant Secure Object Vault [PLANNED]
